body:
spring:
  application:
    name: telemetry-ingestion-and-processing
  r2dbc:
    url: ${R2DBC_URL:r2dbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/telemetry?schema=ledger}
    username: ${DB_USER:telemetry}
    password: ${DB_PASSWORD:}
  flyway:
    enabled: true
    url: ${FLYWAY_URL:jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/telemetry}
    user: ${DB_USER:telemetry}
    password: ${DB_PASSWORD:}
    locations: classpath:db/migration
    schemas: ledger
server:
  shutdown: graceful
pulsestream:
  telemetry:
    reorder-window: PT60S
    reorder-buffer-capacity: 1024
    window:
      size: PT60S
      slide: PT10S
    channels:
      validated-samples: 1024
      sequenced-samples: 1024
      backfill-detections: 256
      closed-windows: 256
      revisions-appended: 256
      stream-publications: 256
      stream-subscriber-buffer: 256
    boundaries:
      heart_rate:
        min: 30
        max: 240
      power:
        min: 0
        max: 2500
      cadence:
        min: 0
        max: 220
      swim_pace:
        min: 45
